items.title: Anthropic's Mythos claim may put Nvidia’s CUDA moat in a vulnerable spot
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa discusses an Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) claim that its Mythos model got Claude running on AMD (AMD) chips in about three days, raising questions about whether AI can erode the value of Nvidia's (NVDA) CUDA moat.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Techs Tumble As Nvidia May Oust CEO Huang; AI Stocks Slide, But Not AMD
items.summary: Techs fell as Nvidia dived on news that it may oust CEO Jensen Huang. AMD extended gains. Will that spoil Wednesday's rally?

items.title: Meet Ian Buck: The NVIDIA Executive Insiders Believe Is the One Man Who Can Replace Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to oust Jensen Huang, and the company has never named a successor. Ian Buck, a key architect of CUDA who runs Nvidia's hyperscale business, is the name that keeps coming up: an essay in Time called him a 'hugely strong replacement' with endorsements including Jim Cramer's.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Sinks as Jensen Huang Ouster Report Sends Investors Toward AMD, Broadcom
items.summary: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ:AVGO) and Advanced Micro Devices Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD) shares each rose more than 3% in extended trading Wednesday as fresh turmoil surrounding Nvidia Corp. (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang sent investors toward rival chipmakers. Nvidia moved sharply in the other direction. Its shares fell 8.08% after hours to $159.68, according to Benzinga Pro. • Broadcom stock is moving in positive territory. Why is AVGO stock advancing? items.title: More Bad News for NVIDIA. With Board Planning to Boot Jensen Huang, Sam Altman Reveals Master Plan to Stop Buying Their Chips
items.summary: Nvidia fell 7.9% after hours to $160.03 as the Wall Street Journal reported its board is preparing to oust Jensen Huang. The same day, Sam Altman's remarks to Samsung executives laid out OpenAI's plan: vertically integrated infrastructure cheaper than anyone's, including chips it designs itself, which means paying Nvidia less over time.
